segments.name: FLNG
segments.description: Converts LNG carriers into FLNG vessels and contracts them long term so gas resource holders can monetize stranded or flared gas reserves.
segments.evidence: We convert LNG carriers into FLNG vessels or build new FLNG vessels and subsequently contract them to third parties.

segments.name: Corporate and other
segments.description: Holds legacy shipping, vessel management, FSRU services, LNG carrier transportation and administrative services provided to affiliates and third parties.
segments.evidence: All associated legacy shipping activities have been included within the broader Corporate and other segment with retrospective effect.

revenueModel.text: Gas resource holders and energy companies pay long-term liquefaction service fees for FLNG units that liquefy their stranded or flared gas reserves.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer gas resource holders a proven, capital efficient and timely solution to monetize stranded, associated, flared or otherwise underutilized gas reserves.

changes.text: In 2025 the company stopped treating Shipping as a reportable segment, with legacy shipping activities moved into Corporate and other.
changes.evidence: In the first quarter of 2025, we no longer classify Shipping as a reportable segment.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold its last LNG carrier, Golar Arctic, completing its full exit from the legacy shipping business.
changes.evidence: In March 2025, we completed the sale of our last LNG carrier for $24.8 million.
